name: Rajesh
email_source: Institute of Actuaries of India job ad (2021)
subject: Winter internship at Principal Global Services | Pranav, IIT Bombay
why_line: Pricing and valuing long-term products is probability applied to real money, and it's the side of quant finance I'd most like to see from the inside.
body:
Hi Rajesh,

I'm Pranav, a second-year Electrical Engineering student at IIT Bombay. My winter break runs from the last week of November to the first week of January, and I'd love to spend those six weeks learning with the actuarial team at Principal Global Services in Pune.

A bit about me: I'm a Convener of IIT Bombay's Finance Club, I can't resist a good probability puzzle (I competed in Jane Street's Estimathon and was selected for their Game Night), and last winter I spent the same break interning with Ankur Warikoo's team at WebVeda. Alongside classes, I've been tinkering with small quant projects through the Quant and Finance Clubs.

Pricing and valuing long-term products is probability applied to real money, and it's the side of quant finance I'd most like to see from the inside.

I'm happy to pitch in wherever I can be useful. My resume is attached, and I'd love to chat if this sounds like a fit.

Best,
Pranav Jaju
IIT Bombay | +91 88069 22758
